streams.title: Azure Disk Storage Explained: Choose the Right Tier & Save Money
streams.description:
Choosing the right Azure Disk Storage can be the difference between a high-performing application and a budget-draining mistake. In this video, we break down the four main disk types so you can match your workload to the perfect storage solution. From development environments to mission-critical databases, knowing which tier to pick is essential for any IT pro or developer.

We dive deep into the core metrics that define disk performance, including IOPS, throughput, and latency. You will learn the specific use cases for Standard SSD, Premium SSD, Premium SSD v2, and UltraDisk. We also explain the critical differences between OS disks and Data disks, and how you can independently scale performance without being forced to buy more storage capacity than you actually need.

Beyond just speed, we cover the essential security and durability features that keep your data safe. This includes a look at locally redundant storage, zone-redundant storage, and the always-on 256-bit AES encryption that protects your information at rest. Whether you are running a simple web server or a massive SAP HANA database, this guide provides the practical knowledge to optimize your Azure environment for both performance and cost.

streams.title: Microsoft Cloud PKI   Simply Explained
streams.description:
Are you tired of managing shared WiFi passwords and complex VPN logins for your team? Discover how Microsoft Cloud PKI can simplify device security by replacing passwords with digital certificates managed entirely in the cloud. This video breaks down how to move away from traditional, server-heavy infrastructure and embrace a modern approach to identity.

Digital certificates act like a secure company ID badge for your laptops and mobile devices. Instead of relying on easily shared secrets like WiFi codes, certificates use public and private keys to prove a device belongs to your organization without ever revealing sensitive data. We explore why traditional Public Key Infrastructure or PKI was often too heavy for small businesses and how Microsoft Cloud PKI changes the game by moving the machinery into the cloud.

We dive into the technical side of how Intune works with Cloud PKI to issue, renew, and revoke certificates automatically. You will learn about the role of the Certificate Authority, the importance of the SCEP protocol, and how to protect your network while reducing the burden on your IT team. Whether you are looking to secure your office WiFi or streamline VPN access for remote workers, this guide provides the practical knowledge you need to get started with a pilot program.

You will learn the fundamentals of chaos engineering, which is a scientific and repeatable method for finding system weaknesses before they become customer-facing outages. We dive deep into Azure Chaos Studio, a fully managed service that helps you orchestrate these experiments directly within the Azure portal using both service-direct and agent-based faults.

The video covers the essential building blocks of a chaos experiment, including targets, steps, branches, and actions. We walk through a practical scenario involving virtual machine scale sets and availability zones to show how these experiments look in practice. Safety is a top priority, so we also discuss permissions, managed identities, and how to avoid accidental production downtime. Whether you are shifting left in your development cycle or running game days in production, this guide provides the roadmap for continuous resilience validation and building operational confidence.
